name: Multi-Board PCB Manager
description: Manage several PCBs driven by one schematic, and find any component instantly.
description_full:
Multi-Board PCB Manager turns one KiCad schematic into several independent PCB layouts, and keeps track of which board every component belongs on.

What it does:
• Sub-boards that share one schematic through hardlinks, so they can never drift apart
• A cross-board component index: search every board at once, and jump straight to a part
• Assignment rules driven by your schematic hierarchy — one rule per board assigns everything, including parts you add later
• Conflict detection: components placed on two boards, placed somewhere other than where they were assigned, or missing from the schematic entirely
• An update preview — see exactly what will be added, changed, or removed before anything is written
• Inter-board ports, rendered as pads on generated board block footprints
• Doctor: a preflight check with one-click repairs for broken links, unresolved libraries, and stale locks
• A headless CLI for CI — index, cross-reference, conflict checking, DRC, and fabrication output with no GUI

Suited to modular systems, daughterboards, rigid-flex assemblies, and any product whose electronics span more than one board.
